sloka: बबन्ध सागरे सेतुम् यथा चास्य तथा पिता ।स नलेन कृतः सेतुः सागरे मकर आलये ॥६-२२-७२॥।।
transliteration: babandha sāgare setum yathā cāsya tathā pitā ।sa nalena kṛtaḥ setuḥ sāgare makara ālaye ॥6-22-72॥।।

translations.english: The bridge was built on the sea, an abode of crocodiles, was auspicious, glorious, and looked like the street in space (milky path).
